title: feat(record-page): two-row record header — navigation over the record, up to three actions
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEV9LRY8FfTWS7J6T3MwsSL)_

Fixes #35853

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb8qTxAVaE2QKwquQU

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/components` takes four optional members: `RecordTopBarProps.record`, `RecordTopBarStepper.onScope`, `NavigationOverlayProps.recordRow` and `PageHeaderActionsProps.fitWidth`; nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 记录页和侧边抽屉的顶栏改成两行：上面一行是「↑ ↓ 第 N 条，共 M 条 · 视图名」和最右边的 ✕，下面一行是记录图标、更大一号的名称、阶段和审批标签，以及最多 3 个操作按钮。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题（#35853），接在已合入的 #35910（一种打开方式）之后。
- 顶栏默认最多显示 3 个操作（#35593 曾改成 1 个），放不下的按宽度逐个收进「更多」，窄抽屉里显示得少一些；手机上不变。
- 只改前端显示和规格里的描述文字，不改存储；改动可以整体撤回。

## What changes

The record's top bar, on the full page and in the drawer alike, is two rows (#35853):

- **The navigation row (40 px).** When the record came from a list: ↑ ↓ and 「第 N 条，共 M 条 · 视图名」 ("N of M · view"), where M is the count the list matched (the `total` #35910 records in the page's provenance). The view's name links back to the list. When there is no list behind the record (a link, a notification, search): the object's name and no ↑ ↓; on the page the name links to the object's list, and in the drawer it is shown without a link. ✕ sits at the far right in every case. On the page it returns to the list as it was left, or to the object's default list. In the drawer it closes, with ⤢ (open the full page) before it.
- **The record row (48 px).** The record's icon, its name one size larger (`text-base`), its stage and approval tags, then the presence avatars and the managed-by badge, and at the right the record's buttons and ⊟. On the page the two badges used to float over the corner above the tabs. The tabs now start right under the bar, so they stand in the record row instead.
- The drawer shows ↑ ↓ and the count again; #35593 had hidden them. A phone keeps its one-row bar.
- **Action budget 3.** The header bar's default inline budget goes back to 3; #35593 had set the record bar to 1. Actions that do not fit the bar's width fold into 「更多」 one at a time, down to the primary, so a narrow drawer shows fewer. An authored `maxVisible` still wins. A phone still shows one primary action, because its bottom bar holds the host's Edit and one more. There is still one primary-coloured button at a time.
- **The default this changes, stated plainly:** the `page:header` `maxVisible` describe in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` goes from "unset = 1 in a record page's one-row header bar, 3 on any other header" to "unset = 3 on every header. In a record page's header bar the number, authored or not, is an upper bound: actions that do not fit the bar's width fold as well". The `mobileMaxVisible` describe gains "where the host's Edit counts as one". The shape and the accepted values are unchanged: describe text only, a patch bump. The seat L2 (7057806258) ruled this is not a narrowing: nothing an author wrote is refused, and the 1 never shipped in a release. The declaration is the widening arm, for the four optional members above. The level stays `patch` under `Metadata-protocol: none`. `PageHeaderActionsProps.defaultMaxVisible` stays on the exported prop type, but no caller in the tree passes it any more; its JSDoc says the default is 3.
- The same text is in `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (the Default cell), the Studio designer descriptions in `containers.tsx`, the generated `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`, and `sdui.manifest.json` / `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` (regenerated with `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`). This covers #35840 (the designer's `mobileMaxVisible` description and the stale budget comments). It does not close it.
- No stray divider beside an empty toggle slot in the bar.

PR-1 of this pair, #35910 (`Fixes #35854`, one way to open a record), merged as d6be99d50c. This PR restarts the branch from that main.

### Drift from the saved #35853 commits

The #35853 work was saved before #35910 and re-applied here on d6be99d50c:
- **Skipped** `2596f853e` ("list view form help text follows the navigation.mode deprecation; regenerate the sdui manifest"): #35910 landed the final `view.form.ts` text. The manifest regeneration it carried is redone here as its own commit, against this tree.
- **Kept main's scroller padding:** #35937 (`Fixes #35745`) already removed the band above the tabs. The page scroller pads sides and bottom only, and `RecordPageColumns` keeps a 12 px top. The saved commit's own `!pt-0` variant is dropped in favour of main's.
- **Kept the badge move:** presence and managed-by stand in the record row on the page, and in a pane they sit level with the page's first row. It has a changeset line.
- `.changeset/35854-one-way-to-open-a-record.md` stays exactly as #35910 landed it.

## Overlap

- #35977 (draft) shares `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `sdui.manifest.json`, `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`. The only conflict is in the generated `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` (`generatedAt` / `sha256`). Whoever lands second re-runs `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`.
- origin/main merges cleanly.

## Tests

Added:
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/record-top-bar-two-rows-35853.test.tsx`: from a list, ↑ ↓ and 「N of M · view」 with ✕ at the right and the record below; from no list, the object's name and no ↑ ↓; the Chinese count; ⤢ then ✕ in the drawer; a CONTROL without a record row stays one row.
- `ui/e2e/live/record-topbar-35853.spec.ts` (live lane): at 1280 px, the page from a list (navigation row over record row, ✕ at the far right) and from no list (the object, ✕ to its list, no stepper); three authored actions on one line; the drawer's same two rows with the tabs right under; a narrow drawer folding actions into ⋯ instead of wrapping; and the phone's one-row bar that does not overflow.
- Checklist item `records-forms.record-open-path-and-header`.

Updated for the two rows:
- `ui/e2e/live/record-open-path-35854.spec.ts` (title, "N of M", the view's name as the way back).
- `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524`, `.accessibleNames-12625`, `.headerMenuIcons-12529`.
- `recordDrawerStack-26679`, `recordDrawerStack.rootStepper-26679`, `recordPaneGroupScope-28461`.
- `page-header-record-bar-35593`, `ApprovalsInboxPage.queueStepper-34586`.

<details><summary>Local runs (this PR's head)</summary>

- `tsc --noEmit` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/components`: clean.
- vitest: `RecordDetailView*`, `recordDrawer*` / `recordPane*`, and the components record-top-bar / page-header / navigation-overlay / containers tests gave `Test Files 140 passed`, `Tests 1173 passed`. The console `ApprovalsInboxPage.queueStepper-34586` gave 7 passed.
- Live lane (turbo build, `start-backend.sh` on :4010, `vite preview` on :5180): `record-open-path-35854.spec.ts` + `record-topbar-35853.spec.ts` gave `10 passed`.
- `check-sdui-manifest`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration` (non-breaking) and `check-changeset-no-major` all pass.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Read first, by risk: `ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx` (the two rows, width folding), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (the record row, the badges), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx` (✕ and the way back).
- Two-minute check: open a record from an object list in the Console. The bar is two rows: ↑ ↓ 「第 2 条，共 M 条 · 视图名」 and ✕ over the record's name and up to three buttons. ↓ steps, and ✕ returns to the list. Open the hover icon's drawer and see the same two rows in the card.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
